title.rendered: Orrery Labs raises £900k pre-seed for satellite thermal control

content.rendered:
Orrery Labs, a Glasgow company incorporated in March 2026, has raised a £900,000 pre-seed round led by an angel syndicate to commercialise its passive thermal-control panels for small satellites.

The company was founded by two former engineers at a Scottish space contractor.

title.rendered: European AI startups secure record share of VC capital

content.rendered: A new report finds European AI companies took a record share of venture capital in the first half of 2026. The analysis covers more than four hundred rounds.

title.rendered: Hartwell Diagnostics secures seed funding for at-home testing

content.rendered: Hartwell Diagnostics, incorporated in Leeds in January 2026, has secured a seed round to scale its at-home sample-collection kits. The round was led by a Yorkshire fund.
